verdict.rationale: Superhuman ships a first-party Superhuman Mail MCP server, documented on a dedicated feature page and confirmed by probe. It connects inbox and calendar to Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants for summarizing, drafting, sending and scheduling, across multiple Gmail/Outlook accounts, and every send requires explicit approval. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP connection, and technical setup details such as endpoint, auth flow and exposed tool list.
